description: Different model profiles should preserve module-local Go workspace command ownership and direct standard-library test evidence.

lockedFields.reason: A literally declared workspace member should retain its module-local verification command.
The complete repository-contained workspace graph should not introduce an ownership blocker.
The directly exercised checkout service should remain an extend-test item.
The workspace-owned service should retain its stable module-local plan identifier.
Test provenance must stay relative to the owning module rather than the workspace root.
The checkout test should retain direct Go symbol evidence.
The owned checkout function remains directly called by its runnable test.
